caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The table has a round, dark reddish-brown top with a slightly raised rim. The tabletop is supported by a single, turned central pedestal, which narrows towards the middle before widening again and then tapering down. At the base, the pedestal branches out into three outwardly curving legs, each ending in a small, rounded foot. The overall appearance of the table is smooth and polished, and there are no additional objects or details in the composition aside from the table itself.
title: Candlestand
